name: Frontend
label: For frontend roles
description: Learn frontend development from HTML to production-ready Next.js.

stages.title: HTML
stages.description: Learn how to structure accessible and searchable web pages.
stages.topics: Document structure, semantic HTML, forms and validation, tables, images, audio, video, accessibility, SEO metadata

stages.title: CSS
stages.description: Build responsive layouts and understand how browser styling works.
stages.topics: Selectors, cascade, specificity, inheritance, box model, units, positioning, Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, transitions, animations, custom properties

stages.title: Git and Vercel deployment
stages.description: Track your work and publish frontend applications confidently.
stages.topics: Git basics, commits, branches, merging, pull requests, GitHub, environment variables, preview deployments, production deployments

stages.title: JavaScript
stages.description: Learn the language and browser APIs used in everyday frontend work.
stages.topics: Variables, data types, operators, functions, arrays, objects, DOM, events, modules, error handling, fetch, promises, async and await

stages.title: Tailwind CSS
stages.description: Use a utility-first CSS framework to build consistent interfaces.
stages.topics: Utility classes, responsive variants, state variants, layout, spacing, typography, colors, theme configuration, reusable component patterns

stages.title: Advanced JavaScript
stages.description: Understand the language behavior behind complex applications.
stages.topics: Scope, closures, hoisting, prototypes, this, event loop, microtasks, advanced promises, iterators, generators, memory, performance

stages.title: React
stages.description: Learn a component framework for building interactive applications.
stages.topics: Components, JSX, props, state, hooks, forms, routing, data fetching, context, performance, testing

stages.title: TypeScript and Next.js
stages.description: Add type safety and learn a production React framework.
stages.topics: Types, interfaces, unions, generics, narrowing, App Router, layouts, routing, Server Components, Client Components, data fetching, caching, route handlers, metadata

name: Backend
label: For backend roles
description: Learn backend development from APIs and databases to scalable production systems.

stages.title: Language and runtime foundations
stages.description: Build confidence in one backend language and its runtime.
stages.topics: Language syntax, data types, functions, OOP, modules, package management, error handling, asynchronous programming, memory basics, debugging, clean code

stages.title: APIs and networks
stages.description: Understand how clients and backend services communicate.
stages.topics: HTTP, HTTPS, request methods, status codes, headers, cookies, CORS, REST, API versioning, validation, pagination, DNS, TCP/IP, WebSockets

stages.title: Databases
stages.description: Store, query, and evolve application data safely.
stages.topics: Relational modelling, SQL, joins, normalization, indexes, transactions, ACID, NoSQL, schema design, ORMs, migrations, connection pooling

stages.title: Authentication and security
stages.description: Protect users, application data, and public endpoints.
stages.topics: Password hashing, sessions, cookies, JWT, OAuth, authorization, role-based access, input validation, SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, secrets, rate limiting

stages.title: Caching and asynchronous work
stages.description: Improve response times and move heavy work off request paths.
stages.topics: Caching strategies, Redis, cache invalidation, background jobs, message queues, pub-sub, retries, idempotency, scheduled jobs, event-driven systems

stages.title: Systems and scale
stages.description: Design services that remain reliable as usage grows.
stages.topics: Load balancing, horizontal scaling, replication, partitioning, consistency, CAP theorem, service boundaries, fault tolerance, availability, system design trade-offs

stages.title: Testing, observability, and deployment
stages.description: Prepare backend services for production and ongoing maintenance.
stages.topics: Unit testing, integration testing, API testing, logging, metrics, tracing, health checks, Docker, environment variables, CI/CD, cloud deployment, monitoring

name: DSA Practice
label: For coding rounds
description: Practise core data structures and finish with a no-hints mixed round.

stages.title: Arrays, strings, and complexity
stages.description: Build the foundation for analysing and solving common problems.
stages.topics: Arrays, strings, time complexity, space complexity

stages.title: Recursion, binary search, and sorting
stages.description: Learn core techniques for dividing and ordering problem spaces.
stages.topics: Recursion, binary search, sorting

stages.title: Linked lists, stacks, and queues
stages.description: Learn pointer movement and ordered data processing.
stages.topics: Linked lists, stacks, queues

stages.title: Trees
stages.description: Understand hierarchical data and recursive traversal.
stages.topics: Tree traversal, binary search trees, tree height

stages.title: Graphs
stages.description: Traverse connected data and identify cycles.
stages.topics: BFS, DFS, cycle detection

stages.title: Hashing and window patterns
stages.description: Recognise efficient patterns for arrays and strings.
stages.topics: Hashing, sliding window, two pointers

stages.title: Dynamic programming
stages.description: Solve optimization problems using reusable subproblems.
stages.topics: Knapsack, longest common subsequence, longest increasing subsequence

stages.title: No-hints practice
stages.description: Solve a mixed problem without being told which pattern to use.
stages.topics: Any topic, no hints
